**The AI clarity layer for  insurance**

Understand what you’re covered  for before it matters. 

Pitch Deck ![][image1]  
**Problem.** 

**Insurance is only understood when something goes wrong.** Documents are scattered across emails, PDFs and portals.   
Policies are written for compliance, not comprehension. 

Customers don’t know what they’re covered for until they need it.

![][image2]  
**Insight.** 

**Insurance has gone digital. Understanding has not.** 

Customers don’t wake up wanting to read a policy. 

They start with a question, a decision, or a moment of uncertainty. 

*“Am I covered?” “What do I have?” “What should I ask next?”* 

**Better clarity creates better conversations — with brokers, advisers and insurers.![][image3]**  
**Solution.** 

**Hello David turns insurance spend into insurance intelligence.** AI automatically curates your insurance footprint into an always-on profile. Ask David what you have, what it means and where you need clarity. 

Use that knowledge to ask sharper questions, unlock better value and get more from your  insurer or adviser.

![][image4]  
**The AI / Data Advantage.**

**The value compounds as the insurance profile grows.** 

Hello David builds a structured understanding of each customer’s insurance  footprint over time. 

Every renewal, policy change and provider interaction adds context. 

The result is a smarter insurance profile that helps customers make better  decisions and get more value from their spend. 

![][image5]**hello david**   
**Revenue Model.**

**Start free. Monetise when insurance clarity creates economic  value.**   
**![][image6]![][image7]**
